model_annotations.Bulgarian: This line plot, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct components: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis represents the “Layer,” ranging from 0 to 22 with tick labels at intervals of 5, indicating the layer index in a neural network. The y-axis represents the “Max Activation Value,” scaled linearly from 0 to 1600. The plot contains four lines: attn_output is shown as a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting near 0 and rising to approximately 200 by layer 22; attn_residual is an orange dotted line with circular markers, beginning near 0, peaking above 1500 around layer 5, and then declining slightly before rising again to about 1500 near layer 22; ffn_output is a green dashed line with circular markers, starting near 0, sharply increasing to a peak of approximately 1200 at layer 5, then dropping to near 0 by layer 10, with a brief spike to about 1000 at layer 15 before falling again; and ffn_residual is a red solid line with circular markers, starting near 0, rising sharply to a peak above 1500 at layer 5, remaining relatively stable near 1600 until layer 20, then declining to approximately 600 by layer 22.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line plot, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct components: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 25 with tick marks at regular intervals of 5, labeled "Layer". The y-axis represents the "Max Activation Value," scaled linearly from 0 to 1600. The plot displays four lines: attn_output is shown as a blue dashed line with circular markers; attn_residual is an orange dotted line with circular markers; ffn_output is a green dashed line with square markers; and ffn_residual is a red solid line with circular markers. The ffn_residual line (red) exhibits the highest activation values, peaking near 1600 at layer 5 and remaining above 1400 through layer 25. The attn_residual line (orange) follows a similar trend, peaking near 1600 at layer 5 and declining to around 1400 by layer 25. The ffn_output line (green) shows sharp peaks at layer 5 (around 1300) and layer 15 (around 1000), with values dropping to near zero after layer 20. The attn_output line (blue) remains near zero until layer 20, then rises to approximately 200 at layer 25.
model_annotations.English: This line plot, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers of a neural network model, comparing four distinct activation pathways: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The horizontal x-axis represents the layer index, ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5 units (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 22), labeled “Layer.” The vertical y-axis represents the “Max Activation Value,” scaled linearly from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The plot contains four lines: attn_output (blue dashed line) starts near zero, rises sharply after layer 5, and reaches approximately 200 by layer 22; attn_residual (orange dotted line) begins near zero, spikes to approximately 1500 at layer 5, remains elevated around 1500–1600 until layer 20, then drops to about 600; ffn_output (green dashed line) begins near zero, rises sharply to approximately 1200 at layer 5, then drops to near zero by layer 10, with a brief resurgence to about 1200 at layer 15 before declining again; ffn_residual (red solid line) starts near zero, rises to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains high until layer 20, then drops to about 600 before rising again to approximately 1400 near layer 22.
